title: Three into the basket
description: Three wood balls hang in the air near the top at (80, 280), (200, 280), and (320, 280), and all fall from the start. A basket 50 cm wide and 40 cm deep stands on the floor with its floor centred at (200, 0.5). The build zone covers x from 20 to 380 and y from 50 to 260. All three balls have to come to rest in the basket.
